title: Can Christian Faith Be Born Anew?
excerpt: A lot of us have heard a lot of sermons about the need for “sinners” to be saved, born again, or converted. Now we’re daring to wonder: Can Christianity experience for itself the things it has preached for others? Can Christianity be saved? Can Christian faith be born anew? –…
body:
A lot of us have heard a lot of sermons about the need for “sinners” to be saved, born again, or converted. Now we’re daring to wonder: Can Christianity experience for itself the things it has preached for others? Can Christianity be saved? Can Christian faith be born anew?

 – The Great Spiritual Migration (available September 20, 2016)
